scenes.heading: Diversifying income so one platform change can't end your business

sents.d: Diversifying income so one platform change can't end your business
Relying on a single platform is one of the biggest risks in this field.

scenes.heading: One platform is a single point of failure

sents.d: An algorithm change, account suspension, or shift in platform priorities can dramatically reduce reach overnight — creators who rely entirely on one platform for income are especially exposed to this risk.

scenes.heading: Own an email list or community

sents.d: Building an email list or community on a platform you control (rather than only a following on a platform you don't) gives you a way to reach your audience directly regardless of what happens to any single social platform.

scenes.heading: Point followers to what you own

sents.d: Treating each social platform as a channel for discovery, while directing engaged followers toward something you own — an email list, a paid community, your own product — reduces dependency on any one platform's continued goodwill.

take: Use platforms for discovery, but build something you own.
